request.query: cardinality of multivariate polynomials with degree bound in each variable and bounded natural integer coefficients

items.name: Polynomial.card_eq_of_natDegree_le_of_coeff_le
items.type:
∀ {n : ℕ} {B₁ B₂ : Fin (n + 1) → ℝ},
  {p | p.natDegree ≤ n ∧ ∀ (i : Fin (n + 1)), B₁ i ≤ ↑(p.coeff ↑i) ∧ ↑(p.coeff ↑i) ≤ B₂ i}.ncard =
    ∏ i, (⌊B₂ i⌋ - ⌈B₁ i⌉ + 1).toNat

items.name: MvPolynomial.cardinalMk_le_max
items.type:
∀ {σ R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R],
  Cardinal.mk (MvPolynomial σ R) ≤ max (max (Cardinal.mk R) (Cardinal.mk σ)) Cardinal.aleph0

items.name: MvPolynomial.cardinalMk_le_max_lift
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R],
  Cardinal.mk (MvPolynomial σ R) ≤
    max (max (Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk R)) (Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk σ))) Cardinal.aleph0

items.name: MvPolynomial.cardinalMk_eq_max
items.type:
∀ {σ R : Type u} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nonempty σ] [Nontrivial R],
  Cardinal.mk (MvPolynomial σ R) = max (max (Cardinal.mk R) (Cardinal.mk σ)) Cardinal.aleph0

items.name: MvPolynomial.cardinalMk_eq_max_lift
items.type:
∀ {σ : Type u} {R : Type v} [inst : CommSemiring R] [Nonempty σ] [Nontrivial R],
  Cardinal.mk (MvPolynomial σ R) =
    max (max (Cardinal.lift.{u, v} (Cardinal.mk R)) (Cardinal.lift.{v, u} (Cardinal.mk σ))) Cardinal.aleph0
